status_semantics.DONE: current provider-view behavior already satisfies the target eligibility rule
status_semantics.PARTIAL: mitigation exists but automatic provider visibility or lifecycle leakage remains
status_semantics.OPEN: current behavior conflicts with the target eligibility rule or lacks the required gate
status_semantics.KEEP: surface is intentionally eligible under the stated narrow condition

target_classes.ALWAYS_INLINE: must remain in provider context by contract
target_classes.ACTIVE_EPHEMERAL: eligible only while the current unresolved run/turn needs it; consumed immediately afterwards
target_classes.ACTIVE_STATE: canonical current effective state only; historical versions are retrievable
target_classes.REF_ON_DEMAND: default no body; hydrate only when current task dependency is proven
target_classes.OBSERVABILITY_ONLY: event/state/tool/UI surface; zero prompt by default
target_classes.PROTOCOL_ONLY: retain only the minimum bytes required by provider protocol
target_classes.CONDITIONAL_EXTERNAL: external message becomes eligible only when it is an actual current task/control dependency

entries.current_behavior: R6 freezes canonical current human text and makes it the exact semantic tail of the initial human-ingress provider envelope.
entries.target_rule: Never retire, summarize, rewrite or duplicate the current human text.
entries.retrieval_path: not_applicable

entries.current_behavior: assistant(tool_calls) and matching tool results stay in the active protocol chain.
entries.target_rule: Keep while the current run requires protocol/result consumption; after a resolved final answer, retire the old tool chain from default future-turn projection.
entries.retrieval_path: resolved_episode_ref

entries.current_behavior: R8.8 keeps the R8.5 durable-first retirement path and adds conservative pre-R8.5 migration proof from durable event logs. A legacy final answer migrates only when one run segment has exactly one matching assistant message.appended followed by run.end(reason=completed,truncated=false) with matching answer_preview; corrupt/missing/ambiguous proof stays provider-visible fail-open. Read-only runtime census: 136/182 legacy completed-model answers were provable across 19/19 legacy sessions; 46 remained unretired rather than guessed.
entries.target_rule: Once answered/resolved, default future prompt visibility is zero. Explicit follow-up/continuation may hydrate required fragments from an episode index.
entries.retrieval_path: search_records(kind=episode, query="") -> stable episode ref; keyword/ref hydration with bounded paging; unproven legacy history remains visible until proof exists

entries.current_behavior: R8.20 adds a consumed-tool-span lifecycle independent from whole-episode resolution. At next human ingress, exact complete assistant(tool_calls)+tool receipt spans are retired only when a later real non-tool model assistant has consumed them and EpisodeStore durably indexes user + raw tool evidence + consumer. User instruction and consumer answer remain visible unless the whole episode separately proves resolved. Incomplete/current protocol and program finals remain visible.
entries.target_rule: Raw tool protocol is working context only until a real model consumer exists. After durable toolspan indexing, retire declarations/results from default provider view; keep unresolved task text and consumer answer, and recover exact evidence on demand.
entries.retrieval_path: EpisodeStore toolspan ref via search_records(kind=episode), searchable by tool-result transcript content; exact visible chain hydrated on demand with bounded paging

entries.current_behavior: R8.21 binds historical reasoning replay to the actual provider selected for each request attempt. Local/cognilocal and non-thinking MiniMax replay none; GLM replays only assistant reasoning attached to tool-call turns; DeepSeek official tools requests retain all still-visible assistant reasoning required by protocol; unknown providers fail-safe to configured policy. Cross-provider fallback rebuilds the provider message view for each candidate instead of reusing the primary projection. Resolved/consumed history remains retired before this protocol-only projection, and private reasoning is never duplicated into EpisodeStore hydration.
entries.target_rule: Retain only reasoning bytes still required by the active provider protocol/pairing. Resolved historical reasoning is archive-only.
entries.retrieval_path: Visible resolved transcript is episode-hydratable; private reasoning is intentionally not duplicated as retrieval content

entries.current_behavior: R8.22 removes conversational history as an automatic authority source. A resolved user turn retires even if it contains standing-rule wording or a legacy resolved_episode_keep_provider marker; exact source text remains EpisodeStore-hydratable. MemoryStore decision/convention entries are runtime recall-only for automatic projection, including legacy inject_policy=auto entries, while new decision/convention extraction persists recall_only directly. Current user instructions remain exact inline under E01. Stable always-on rules belong to the versioned rule/config/control plane rather than an old chat turn.
entries.target_rule: Historical conversational decisions/constraints are retrievable by default, not automatically projected. Current user instructions stay inline; any truly always-on rule must have explicit stable rule/config authority rather than inheriting authority from historical wording.
entries.retrieval_path: Resolved source turn via EpisodeStore/search_records(kind=episode); decision/convention via search_records(kind=memory) including exact memory:<id>; MemoryStore current version + version_history preserve supersession history

entries.current_behavior: R8.8 makes persisted memory automatic eligibility identity-bound rather than recency-bound: only memory_snapshot.metadata.turn_ref exactly equal to the current human turn may remain in flat provider history or Cognitive packet input. Older, legacy-without-turn_ref, and resolved snapshots are omitted from automatic projection while durable search_records(kind=memory) retrieval remains available.
entries.target_rule: Eligible only for the current active task dependency. Resolved turn snapshots become retrievable-only. Recency/K is not eligibility.
entries.retrieval_path: search_records(kind=memory) / exact memory ref; resolved visible episode transcript via episode ref

entries.current_behavior: R8.15 retires the generic post-tool experience/skill catalog from automatic working context. _inject_experience_tips is now an observability-only compatibility hook: it does not query ExperienceStore/skills and does not append Message/session history. Canonical historical injection_kind=experience_tip messages are denied centrally from provider view, including same-turn R3 pointer frames. Explicit experience search and failure-specific recovery remain available.
entries.target_rule: Experience/skill knowledge is on-demand by default. Tool-name similarity, front-K, task-switch wording and unseen refs are relevance signals but never sufficient required-now proof. Generic experience enters working context only through an explicit retrieval/tool result; failure-specific recovery may surface after an actual current failure under its separate typed/guidance policy.
entries.retrieval_path: search_records(kind=experience) keyword/exact experience:<id>; explicit skill tools; current-failure typed/guidance recovery

entries.current_behavior: R8.18 retires automatic SessionDigest catalog projection. digest_enabled remains a diagnostic/retrieval capability flag only; build emits/persists zero session_digest_catalog messages. Legacy canonical catalog frames are centrally denied while ordinary human text is preserved.
entries.target_rule: Catalog stays outside prompt by default; historical detail is retrieved explicitly through search_archive / digest ref when needed.
entries.retrieval_path: search_archive / digest archive ref; resolved episode ref when catalog belonged to a retired episode

entries.current_behavior: R8.17 removes compression/archive/fold/cache-degrade occurrence from provider working context. Archive and fold mechanics still execute and remain observable through compact_view_stats, message.cache_compacted events, cache-monitor degradation state and run.compact action telemetry. Dynamic archive counts, fold counts and ref=archive:search_archive frames are no longer emitted. The stable system prompt truthfully advertises archive recovery with search_archive without claiming retired compression-status/catalog/key-fact frames. Legacy anchor-mode current-decision compatibility is kept as a separate compact_active_state_appendix active-state surface, not E10 observability.
entries.target_rule: Archive/fold/cache-degrade occurrence and dynamic counts are observability only. Historical content is retrieved explicitly through search_archive. A current active decision, when separately proven eligible, must not regain authority merely because it shares a compact build path.
entries.retrieval_path: search_archive / ArchiveStore; compact_view_stats / message.cache_compacted / cache monitor / run.compact action telemetry for observability

entries.current_behavior: R5 keeps raw archive but strips identity/self-description details from derived long-term summary/index projection.
entries.target_rule: Keep existing R5 behavior.
entries.retrieval_path: search_archive(with_summary=false) for explicit raw retrieval

entries.current_behavior: R4 new recovery is a closed one-shot runtime slot bound to the current human turn; legacy persisted recovery is filtered from provider view.
entries.target_rule: Keep one-shot semantics; never make recovery durable executable conversation history.
entries.retrieval_path: program.recovery audit event for history, not prompt

entries.current_behavior: R8.8 removes model-switch chat-text replay entirely. A real transition records model.switch observability only; it does not copy recent user/assistant text, append session/tail prompt messages, or issue a program "continue" command.
entries.target_rule: Model routing change is runtime state. Zero prompt by default. If an active task must be resumed, hydrate canonical active-task state rather than chat text.
entries.retrieval_path: model.switch action/event observability; active-task continuity comes from canonical active state or explicit retrieval, never copied recent chat text

entries.current_behavior: R8.9 removes declaration_reminder from prompt/session history entirely. Declaration validation happens after the model final answer already exists, so discrepancies now remain in LoopResult/UI plus declaration_check audit/action telemetry. New runs emit no reminder message; pre-R8.9 legacy reminders are denied only when they match the exact historical fixed program sentence, preserving genuine user discussion of the label.
entries.target_rule: Audit/UI or pre-delivery correction only; never persist as next-turn prompt material.
entries.retrieval_path: LoopResult.verification_note / declaration_check audit / action telemetry

entries.current_behavior: R8.9 stamps stagnation_reminder with prompt_lifecycle=current_turn and exact human turn_ref. It remains visible to later LLM/tool rounds inside that human turn, then loses prompt eligibility on the next human ingress. Legacy unlabelled stagnation system frames are centrally denied as historical control state.
entries.target_rule: If model guidance is still needed, visible only inside the unresolved run. Program-side breaker/telemetry owns persistence.
entries.retrieval_path: action_trace / stagnation audit

entries.current_behavior: R8.9 stamps empty_search_reminder with prompt_lifecycle=current_turn and exact human turn_ref. It can guide retries inside the unresolved human turn but cannot survive into the next human task. Legacy unlabelled empty-search system frames are centrally denied; path_registry/action truth remains durable.
entries.target_rule: Prefer program-side negative-evidence handling. If visible to model, consume at run end and never leak to next independent task.
entries.retrieval_path: path_registry / action_trace

entries.current_behavior: R8.9 gives overflow_feedback explicit STATUS/program metadata, prompt_lifecycle=current_turn, and exact human turn_ref. The first-overflow reinjection remains available to the next LLM attempt in the same human turn, then expires automatically; legacy unlabelled overflow system frames are centrally denied.
entries.target_rule: Same-run control only; audit/runtime state after consumption.
entries.retrieval_path: exception/action audit

entries.current_behavior: R8.8 consumes round-exhaustion control by metadata identity injection_kind=round_exhaustion_decision rather than visible prefix, and moves the consumed mutation before session.save so the lifecycle state survives reload. The message remains current-run ephemeral and cannot resurrect in a later human turn.
entries.target_rule: One current-run decision only; consumed by metadata identity rather than visible string prefix.
entries.retrieval_path: run.end/action audit

entries.current_behavior: Messages marked injected_system (and compatible legacy system prefixes) are removed from provider history when skip_injected_system=true.
entries.target_rule: Keep out of prompt; expose through architecture_status/event/UI.
entries.retrieval_path: architecture_status / event records

entries.current_behavior: R8.11 consumes cache gate_note_pending as one-shot runtime observability and records run.cache_gate observed_only telemetry with prompt_chars=0. The live build producer is removed and gate_note is no longer in the dynamic prompt allowlist. Legacy GATE_NOTE_CONTENT/restore/parser support remains only for historical err1210/defer compatibility; restored markers are consumed/retired without provider replay.
entries.target_rule: Cache/prefix-health intervention state is runtime observability only; it must never add program-authored natural-language advice to provider input.
entries.retrieval_path: cache monitor snapshot / architecture status / action trace

entries.current_behavior: R8.11 keeps injection-budget pruning as structured InjectionBudgetResult + action telemetry only. receipt_content still describes the pruning decision for observability, but no receipt BudgetBlock is created/reserved/charged and build never appends the receipt to wire or cognitive packet. used_chars now measures actual kept prompt blocks only.
entries.target_rule: Prompt-budget bookkeeping is control-plane observability. Budget decisions may prune prompt material but must not themselves consume prompt budget or create model-facing prose.
entries.retrieval_path: LoopEngine._last_injection_budget / action.injection_budget trace / architecture status

entries.current_behavior: R8.8 removes every-build Evidence Recovery Manifest projection from build, closing the R2 bypass. Ledger, ManifestProjector, source reuse and read/search/list recovery remain durable control-plane capabilities. list_evidence(scope=recovery) explicitly returns the same bounded prioritized manifest on demand, preserving queryless discovery without automatic prompt bytes.
entries.target_rule: Evidence ledger remains tool-addressable. Do not inject the manifest/index by default; hydrate only a proven current dependency.
entries.retrieval_path: list_evidence(scope=recovery) for bounded queryless discovery; list_evidence(scope=recent) / search_evidence / read_evidence for targeted recovery

entries.current_behavior: R8.16 retires the full automatic task_frontier producer. Build now auto-projects only a byte-stable task_active identity when the active Goal has exactly one in_progress task: goal_id + task_id + status=in_progress + one-line title. Zero or multiple in_progress tasks produce zero task prompt chars. Ready/blocked/unreachable/completed/premise_stale/counts and task-operation guidance remain outside automatic prompt. The old task_frontier slot is centrally deny-listed by absence from the prompt producer allowlist, preventing a future full-graph producer from regaining authority by reusing the old slot name.
entries.target_rule: Only a uniquely bound current execution identity may be automatic active state. Full graph, candidate selection, blocked/unreachable/completed state and task bookkeeping guidance are tool-only by default; ambiguous or non-executable graphs auto-project nothing.
entries.retrieval_path: task_frontier() full graph / get_goal task summary / get_tool_schema discovery

entries.current_behavior: R8.14 keeps task_hotcard as a durable handoff artifact but removes all automatic prompt authority. build no longer pops/injects/consumes a card on cross-session entry; pop/reset require explicit authorized=True; legacy HOTCARD err1210 defer is dropped rather than reset/replayed; and hotcard is removed from the central dynamic prompt producer allowlist.
entries.target_rule: Cross-session, unconsumed state, recency, or origin mismatch never proves continuation. A hotcard may be read/consumed only after an explicit input-side user restore/accept action (or another future canonical authorization mechanism with equivalent user authority). Durable handoff/archive state remains retrievable without entering provider working context by default.
entries.retrieval_path: data/handoff/task_hotcard.json via read_file; handoff_now artifact + ArchiveStore/search_archive; explicit authorized pop helper

entries.current_behavior: R8.12 removes automatic prompt authority from interop topic=notify and backlog-count notices. First-seen and duplicate notify files are archived directly to lfl_to_dsh/done with body preserved for UI/retrieval, and compact interop.notify action telemetry records prompt_chars=0. Pending backlog depth is action/watchdog observability only; no synthetic "另有 N 条" Message is created. Subagent reports remain semantically available through SubAgentResult/spawn_subagent tool receipts, so their notify copy is no longer a duplicate model-input channel. Coordinate/task messages remain unchanged for E26 conditional-external audit.
entries.target_rule: notify/job-complete/subagent-copy/backlog are event/UI state and never automatic model prompt. If the current task needs a result, retrieve it explicitly through job_output/interop state/tool receipt; true coordinate/task changes are governed separately by E26.
entries.retrieval_path: interop Web UI recent_done/event/action trace / job_output / spawn_subagent tool receipt

entries.current_behavior: R8.13 removes automatic prompt authority from interop coordinate/task. Pending external items remain in interop state/UI and are not consumed into Message/provider wire. The factory watcher records only global action observability: it no longer attributes an external item to the most-recent session and never fabricates user_text or starts a model run. Legacy in-memory interop tail/defer state is retired before build, and the central dynamic producer allowlist no longer contains interop.
entries.target_rule: External coordinate/task has zero automatic provider eligibility. A message may enter model working context only after an input-side user authorization/accept-insert action turns it into genuine user-authorized task input; session/ref targeting alone is not authorization. Without that authorization it stays retrievable in interop state/UI.
entries.retrieval_path: interop pending/Web UI + global action observability; explicit future accept/insert input path

entries.current_behavior: R8.9 stops appending post-fallback notices to session prompt history because the fallback call has already returned before the notice exists. Successful fallback state remains in model_fallback status/audit/action observability. When all candidates fail, the detailed fallback summary is surfaced in the current program final result rather than as a future system prompt notice. Legacy fallback system notices are centrally denied.
entries.target_rule: Fallback routing/status is observability. Current all-failed details belong in the current program result; no post-response fallback notice has future prompt authority.
entries.retrieval_path: model_fallback status/event/action; current all-failed program result

entries.current_behavior: R8.8 deletes the provider_id==local per-build command-shaped behavior patch. Local routing no longer grants evaluation/autonomy/search guidance dynamic prompt authority.
entries.target_rule: Remove from dynamic prompt. If any rule is truly authoritative, place it once in stable system/rules; evaluation patches do not gain production prompt authority.
entries.retrieval_path: not_applicable

entries.current_behavior: R8 profile recommendation is emitted as injection.profile.shadow event and applied=false; capability-only tests prove messages+tools byte identity.
entries.target_rule: Keep telemetry outside prompt until a separately approved behavior policy consumes it after eligibility.
entries.retrieval_path: event log

entries.current_behavior: Legacy cache hit-rate lines in assistant content are stripped in build provider view; authoritative cache data is transported separately.
entries.target_rule: Keep telemetry out of conversational prompt.
entries.retrieval_path: cache telemetry/event

entries.current_behavior: R8.7 applies a stable CORE9 plus current task/protocol/recovery-needed tool projection to local and cloud providers. Hidden healthy tools remain registered and discoverable through get_tool_schema catalog/search/exact lookup. Playwright is runtime-quarantined when unavailable; MCP tools/list=0 yields no live capability. Clean-source simple surface is 9 tools / 3,425 raw lazy chars (3,714 provider-wrapper chars) versus 61 / 22,699 all-lazy raw chars.
entries.target_rule: Expose a stable universal core plus task/state-relevant tools only; discover secondary schemas on demand. DEGRADED/QUARANTINED tools require runtime-health and failure-class recovery policy before visibility.
entries.retrieval_path: get_tool_schema

entries.current_behavior: R8.19 removes the model-facing interruption recovery note. When event-log replay contains durable messages missing from the live session view, runtime performs a semantic prefix reconcile and inserts only replay-only historical messages before the live current user. Ambiguous/replay-failure cases fail open to observability only; prompt_chars=0.
entries.target_rule: Runtime repairs event/session divergence deterministically. Interruption/recovery occurrence is observability only and never becomes program-authored model context.
entries.retrieval_path: event_log replay / SessionStore reconciliation; action telemetry for repair outcome

entries.current_behavior: R8.10 removes automatic prompt authority from auxiliary program faults. Initial session_persistence, archive_sink and memory retrieval failures still emit selfheal/status/action/recovery evidence, but no longer append program-authored fault prose to session history or current-turn memory snapshots. Legacy system [程序异常] frames are centrally denied in provider projection. Loop-end session-save failure remains visible to the current user as a program final result; on future turns R8.10 projects that assistant to the fixed program-final protocol boundary instead of replaying fault detail.
entries.target_rule: Program faults are runtime observability/recovery state, not model instructions. Preserve current-user error disclosure where required, but never grant auxiliary fault prose automatic prompt authority; future provider history keeps only protocol shape when needed.
entries.retrieval_path: search_records(kind=selfheal/exception_log) / architecture_status / recovery evidence

entries.current_behavior: R8.8 separates semantic labelling from eligibility. Dynamic prompt producers must match an explicit allowlist before label/profile/budget; an unknown or unattributed slot is dropped and audited as action.prompt_eligibility/unknown_producer_denied. infer_layer keeps its legacy STATUS fallback only for rendering compatibility and can no longer grant prompt access.
entries.target_rule: Unknown prompt producer is not eligible by default. Only an explicit prompt-producer allowlist may enter eligibility/profile/budget.
entries.retrieval_path: producer telemetry only
